$schema: sidecar for DESIGN.md — mirrors frontend/src/app.css :root exactly (every custom property, same values); keep in sync with app.css and DESIGN.md's frontmatter

meta.world: ham-radio waterfall / spectrum scope instrument panel

chassis.note: v42: bg-1 is the raised faceplate (1.17:1 vs bg-0); line is the quiet divider (v47: also a disabled control's edge), line-control the >=3:1 border of every control (WCAG 1.4.11); bg-3 is every neutral control's hover and pressed fill

text.note: v42: dim reaches 4.5:1 on bg-0/1/2 (5.63/4.83/4.62); signal-dim is never text

signal.meaning: live only: something receiving right now with /'s link live; never permanent chrome or decoration (v47: a job row is amber only while one of its tracks downloads or it is expanding, and nothing is amber while the link is down)
signal.note: signal-ink is defined but consumed nowhere as of v47

waiting.meaning: patient, scheduled, not alarming — the retry ladder's and the breaker hold's normal state

fail.meaning: terminal failure only — never used for waiting/backoff
fail.note: v42: fail-edge is a destructive control outline at rest (>=3:1); fail-dim is defined but consumed nowhere as of v47 (never a control's only edge)

overlay.note: v47: the dimmed (never blurred) page behind a modal: the confirmation and the help overlay

focus.meaning: keyboard focus ring, never suppressed (hard accessibility requirement)

families.font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.source: v47: self-hosted via @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans and @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 5.3.0, weights 400/500/600, imported in routes/+layout.svelte

typography.rule: mono = numbers, counts, timestamps, state tokens, addresses, idents (.label), keycaps, the console SUBMIT, value choices (.choice-group.values); sans = content, sentences, errors, and every control label that is a word (v47: buttons, chips, segments, row actions, nav links at fs-detail medium)

scale.note: v42: fixed rem roles; body is var(--fs-body), so text follows the user setting. v47: every font-size in the tree is one of these (plus two `inherit` resets)

space.note: space-7 is defined and unused; space-8 is used once (the unreachable-server screen, routes/+layout.svelte)

rowGrid.note: v41: shared columns of JobRow, TrackRow, the expanded detail and the tracks-scope group header; a nested track list indents by row-nest

control.note: v47: the one height of /'s find and refine rows (segments, search well, chips, sort select); a coarse pointer raises it to 2.75rem

motion.reducedMotion: all three durations zeroed globally under prefers-reduced-motion; every bespoke @keyframes literal-duration animation additionally needs its own override

breakpoints.note: not custom properties (media queries can't read var()); literals in em since v47 (WCAG 1.4.4), equal to the old px at 16px

jobStatusColorMap.expanding: cond-live while the link is live, else cond-idle
jobStatusColorMap.active: cond-live only while >=1 track is downloading and the link is live, else cond-idle (v47)
jobStatusColorMap.settled:partial: cond-fail with a lookup_failed track, else cond-idle (v42)
